content:
In tile units, length = 10 tiles and let breadth = n tiles.  
After a one-tile-wide black border, remaining tiles:

\[
(10-2)(n-2)=8(n-2)
\]

Blue tiles are the remaining two-thirds:

\[
\frac{2}{3} \cdot 8(n-2)=16
\]

\[
\frac{16(n-2)}{3}=16 \Rightarrow n-2=3 \Rightarrow n=5
\]

Thus breadth \(= 5 \times 2 = 10\) feet.

\[
\boxed{10}
\]
